challenge.title: Build an Automated Power BI / Excel L&D Executive KPI Dashboard
challenge.instructions: Connect LMS completion and evaluation data to visualize: 1) Monthly Completion Rate, 2) Kirkpatrick Level 2 Skill Gain, 3) Cost per Learning Hour.

portfolio_evidence.description: An executive-ready dashboard communicating learning effectiveness, adoption velocity, and training ROI.

three_actions.learn: Complete 'Build Interactive Dashboards in Power BI for People Analytics' and 'People Analytics: Transforming HR with Data (Wharton)' (3 hours + 4 weeks (Free to audit)).
three_actions.apply: Build an Automated Power BI / Excel L&D Executive KPI Dashboard (50 mins).
three_actions.capture: Save 'L&D Executive Analytics Dashboard' to your professional career portfolio.
